children.name: Peronospora belbahrii
children.description: Peronospora belbahrii, common name basil downy mildew, is a pathogenic water mold that affects basil species.

children.name: Peronospora destructor
children.description: Peronospora destructor is a plant pathogen.

children.name: Peronospora farinosa
children.description: Peronospora farinosa is a species name that has been widely applied to downy mildew on leaves of wild and cultivated Amaranthaceae: Amaranthus, Atriplex, Bassia, Beta, Chenopodium, Halimione, Salsola, Spinacia, etc.

children.name: Peronospora ficariae

children.name: Peronospora radii
children.description: Peronospora radii is a floricolous downy mildew which infects plants in the Asteraceae.

children.name: Peronospora sparsa
children.description: Peronospora sparsa is an oomycete plant pathogen that causes downy mildew in berry producing plants; especially in the genus's Rubus and Rosa.

children.name: Peronospora violacea
children.description: Peronospora violacea is a floricolous downy mildew which infects plants in the Caprifoliaceae.

children.description: Phytophthora cambivora]] Phytophthora × cambivora is a plant pathogen that causes ink disease in European chestnut trees (Castanea sativa).

children.description: Phytophthora capsici is an oomycete plant pathogen that causes blight and fruit rot of peppers and other important commercial crops.

children.name: Phytophthora cinnamomi
children.description: Phytophthora cinnamomi, also known as cinnamon fungus, is a soil-borne water mould that produces an infection which causes a condition in plants variously called "dieback", "root rot", or (in certain Castanea species), "ink disease".

children.name: Phytophthora cryptogea

children.name: Phytophthora erythroseptica
children.description: Phytophthora erythroseptica—also known as pink rot along with several other species of Phytophthora—is a plant pathogen.

children.name: Phytophthora infestans
children.description: Phytophthora infestans is an oomycete or water mold, a fungus-like microorganism (oomycete) that causes the serious potato and tomato disease known as late blight or potato blight.

children.name: Phytophthora kernoviae
children.description: Phytophthora kernoviae is a plant pathogen that mainly infects European beech (Fagus sylvatica) and Rhododendron ponticum.

children.name: Phytophthora lateralis
children.description: Phytophthora lateralis is a soil-borne plant pathogen that causes cedar root disease in Port Orford cedars (Chamaecyparis lawsoniana).

children.name: Phytophthora megasperma
children.description: Phytophthora megasperma is a species of water mould in the family Peronosporaceae.

children.name: Phytophthora palmivora
children.description: Phytophthora palmivora is an oomycete that causes bud-rot of palms, fruit rot or kole-roga of coconut and areca nut.

children.name: Phytophthora plurivora
children.description: Phytophthora plurivora is a very aggressive soil-borne plant pathogen, with worldwide distribution and a wide variety of hosts.

children.name: Phytophthora ramorum
children.description: Phytophthora ramorum is the oomycete known to cause the disease sudden oak death (SOD).
